implementation.scope: The existing checked complete-label borrowing predicate additionally accepts MapOperation::Binary only when binary_value::changes_metadata accepts the operator: +, -, *, /, %, ^ and atan2. implementation.parameter_order: Scalar parameters finish before the Map frame exists. Arithmetic, scalar side, filtering and diagnostics retain their original execution order.
implementation.unchanged: No fields, caches, ABI/API/provider promises or data formats. Ordinary and Boolean comparisons, unary maps, timestamp/native maps, nested frames, non-Instant selectors and absent/wrong owners retain their previous paths. Current metadata validation, full-byte identity, duplicate/hash/head checks, cancellation and output ownership remain.
implementation.fallback: Current-label mismatches retain full copying, including explicitly accounted comparison work.

changed_label_sweep.scope: Combined counters across abs, clamp_min and both scalar-division sides. Each expression compares complete results/read counts at every changing-label threshold; combined counts do not establish per-expression mismatch totals.
